preconditions.description: K is a positive integer within the bounds of the length of S.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in S)
preconditions.description: S consists only of lowercase alphabets.

postconditions.description: The output is the count of all substrings of length K which have exactly K-1 distinct characters.
